parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the topmost part of the dispenser, made of polypropylene plastic, typically small and ergonomically shaped for finger pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the actuator that, when pressed, pushes liquid through the pump mechanism and dispenses it from the nozzle.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns upward via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head section connects the pressing lid to the pump mechanism and includes the nozzle and internal spring housing.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the tube inside the bottle to the nozzle, ensuring smooth flow during dispensing.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly with the pressing lid and returns to its original position after release.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of polyethylene plastic, typically cylindrical with a rounded top.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid or gel to be dispensed, such as soap, lotion, or sanitizer.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation and serves as the structural support for the pump assembly.
